projects.name: On Multicloud
projects.description:
On Multicloud 09/2021 – Present
Cloud Strategy & Architecture: Designing resilient architectures leveraging Availability Zones, Load Balancers, App Gateways, Scale Sets, and Azure Front Door; establishing Landing Zones with policy-based governance, tagging, and resource organization.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Architecting Terraform- based IaC frameworks using workspaces, modules, dynamic expressions, optional variables, and looping constructs for environment-agnostic deployment and lifecycle management.
Kubernetes & Containers: Implemented AKS clusters with Azure CNI Overlay, Calico network policies, and GitOps-based deployment via ArgoCD; integrated container registries (ACR) with secure image scanning pipelines.
CI/CD & GitOps: Designed Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions pipelines for continuous integration, automated testing, security scanning, and blue–green/canary deployments. Managed pipeline agents, service principals, secrets via Key Vault.
Security & Compliance: Defined Azure Policy, Blueprints, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) to enforce least privilege. Configured NSGs, ASGs, WAFs, and Private Endpoints. Integrated Sentinel, Defender for Cloud, and Key Vault for secrets and certificates.
Monitoring & Observability: Architected monitoring stacks using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, CloudWatch, with proactive alerting, dashboarding, and SLA/SLO-based performance baselines.
Cost & Performance Optimization: Applied FinOps principles—rightsizing VMs, decommissioning idle resources, and implementing budgets, cost alerts, and automation policies to ensure efficient utilization.
Automation & Scripting: Automated deployments, resource scaling, and configuration management with Python SDKs, Azure CLI, and PowerShell for end-to-end lifecycle management.
Collaboration & Mentorship: Partnered with cross- functional teams (Dev, SecOps, and Finance) to align technology with business objectives; mentored DevOps engineers on IaC, pipeline automation, and secure coding best practices.
